mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply conditions, which boosts corporate profit margins and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 9.0% for two consecutive months signals deepening labor market weakness, triggering a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when both INDPRO and RSAFS decline by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a contraction in the housing sector, reducing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when FEDFUNDS > 3.0% and HOUST declines by at least 1.0% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals rising inflation expectations, which typically leads to higher real interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL increases by at least 0.2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which may trigger wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a severe economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when INDPRO declines by at least 0.5% and UNRATE rises by at least 0.2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: During a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 8.0%), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a weakening consumer sector, reducing corporate revenue growth and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when UNRATE > 8.0% and RSAFS declines by at least 0.5% month-over-month.
